title: Account switcher
summary: The menu a long press on the Você tab opens (ADR 0135): every account on this phone with a check on the current one, then Nova conta while the cap allows one more (ADR 0086).

accounts.description: Every account on this phone, oldest first.

canAddAccount.description: true while the phone holds fewer personal accounts than max_accounts (bipe-api GET /v1/me/account, fallback MAX_PERSONAL_ACCOUNTS in the registries).

switchAccount.effect: Closes the menu and runs app-tabs switchAccount.

newAccount.effect: Closes the menu and opens onboarding-welcome to create a second account on this phone. The first account stays signed in.

notes: Each row shows the avatar, the display name and the @handle; never the Matrix ID.
An account with unread messages shows a dot in its row.
Company accounts do not count against the cap (ADR 0086).
